neo.promptSummary: Preserve silver hair, blue eyes and face. Match navy strategist uniform, gold embroidery, white cape and black gloves. yeoni.promptSummary: Preserve pink eyes, long wavy pink hair, face and flower accessory. Replace all clothing with Korean ivory/blush hanbok: jeogori, white dongjeong collar, goreum and full chima, lotus embroidery; not kimono or obi. Landscape sheet with portrait holding tea, full-body views, gentle/listening/thoughtful expressions and Korean tea house. Labels: 연이 / 운명 찻집 마스터 / 따뜻한 공감으로 여는 상담 / 마음을 먼저 듣고, 작은 실천을 함께 찾아요. Remove brands, age, birthday, height, MBTI and credentials.
